text:
You have a preliminary Prezi deck and need it refined, branded, and expanded with a few new frames to match your new SaaS product and branding kit.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While my background is technical, I’ve worked on SaaS-facing presentation and product work where structure, clarity, and brand consistency matter.

In a recent B2B SaaS project, I built embedded customer analytics dashboards so each customer account saw its own metrics. The rollout reached 140 customer accounts and was delivered 3 weeks early.

I can help refine your current Prezi, align it with your branding kit, and add the missing frames so it feels polished and cohesive. I’d also be glad to support future decks as well.
